question: Across all JARVIS-DFT dft_3d entries that carry a full 6x6 elastic tensor: (Q1) how many are certifiably NOT positive definite when the stored decimals are read as exact rationals; (Q2) how many are ambiguous when each printed value may vary within +-1/2 unit in its last printed decimal place; (Q3) how many pass the incorrect linear orthorhombic criterion of Wu et al. 2007 (Mouhat-Coudert Eq. 19) but fail exact positive definiteness; (Q4) where do float pipelines (numpy eigvalsh with/without tolerance) disagree with the exact verdict; (Q5) where do the crystal-system-specific Born conditions of Mouhat-Coudert 2014 disagree with the exact verdict.

dataset.name: JARVIS-DFT 3D dataset, figshare article 6815699 (file jdft_3d-9-24-2025.json.zip; fallback jdft_3d-12-12-2022.json.zip)
dataset.licence_check: figshare API metadata for article 6815699 reports licence 'CC BY 4.0' (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); checked 2026-10-31 BEFORE download. CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution with attribution, but only summaries/counts and code are published here (no bulk redistribution). Attribution: Choudhary et al., npj Comput. Mater. 6, 173 (2020), arXiv 2007.01831; data DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.6815699.
dataset.field: elastic_tensor (6x6, as stored; units as stored, GPa per JARVIS documentation, to be confirmed from the data)

method.reading: Each stored float is converted to the exact rational of its shortest round-trip decimal representation (Python repr -> Fraction(str)). This is an interpretation: the stored decimals are treated as exact numbers; it says nothing about the physical material, only about the printed tensor.
method.symmetry: The energy quadratic form is x^T C x; it depends only on the symmetric part S=(C+C^T)/2 (exact). Verdicts use S. The number of entries whose stored tensor is not exactly symmetric is reported separately.
method.exact_test: LDL^T without pivoting over Fractions on S. PD iff all pivots > 0 (equivalent to all leading principal minors > 0, Sylvester). Class NOT_PD: first pivot d_k <= 0 gives an exact rational witness x (solve L^T x = e_k) with x^T S x = d_k <= 0 (d_k = 0 reported as BOUNDARY, still not PD). Class PD: positive pivots. Independent second implementation: sympy leading-principal-minor determinants on the same rationals; the two must agree on every entry.
method.interval_test: Each of the 36 stored entries is replaced by an interval [c - u/2, c + u/2], u = 10^(-p), p = number of printed decimal places of that entry (shortest repr). ROBUST_PD: exact rational lower bound t on lambda_min(S) (largest dyadic t with S - tI passing the exact LDL^T PD test, by bisection) satisfies t > sqrt(sum of squared half-widths of S entries) (Frobenius bound on the perturbation spectral norm). ROBUST_NOT_PD: nominal witness x gives x^T S x + sum_ij |x_i||x_j| h_ij < 0 exactly. Otherwise AMBIGUOUS. Classified exactly, never by float.
method.linear_orthorhombic: Eq. 19 of Mouhat-Coudert (Wu et al.): Cii>0 (i=1..6), Cii+Cjj-2Cij>0 for i<j<=3, C11+C22+C33+2(C12+C13+C23)>0, evaluated exactly on S. Q3 counts entries PASS_linear and exact NOT_PD.
method.born_cross_check: Mouhat-Coudert 2014 closed-form conditions per Laue class evaluated exactly on the stored entries using the space-group number stored in JARVIS (spg_number). JARVIS tensors are Cartesian-frame DFT output with noise and need not have the exact zero pattern of the class; any disagreement with the full-tensor PD verdict is reported as a frame/noise artefact candidate and NEVER as a database error. Implemented only for the classes whose formulae are in the paper text we read (arXiv 1410.0065); coverage reported.
method.float_pipelines: F0: numpy.linalg.eigvalsh(S).min() > 0. F1: lambda_min > -1e-8 (absolute). F2: lambda_min > -1e-6*lambda_max (relative). Disagreement = float verdict != exact verdict. Float results are Tier X.
method.dft_uncertainty_context: Tier X only: margin lambda_min_lower/||S||_F reported with thresholds 1%,2%,5%,10%,20% as an illustrative stand-in for DFT finite-difference uncertainty (no uncertainty is stored in the dataset; the thresholds are not a statement about JARVIS accuracy).
method.dataset_flags: Report factually: entries with non-finite or 'na' tensors, non-symmetric tensors, all-zero tensors, duplicate jid, any stored stability field. No contact with dataset authors; discrepancies are the owner's to forward.
method.lean: Stretch component. Via scripts/certified_numerics/lean_pinned.py (pinned imports, no import Mathlib, axioms within {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}): (a) positive control footnote-26 witness x^T C x < 0; (b) a PD LDL^T certificate for a diamond-type control; (c) a tampered certificate that must be REJECTED; (d) if time, a few dataset NOT_PD witnesses. Anything not kernel-checked stays Tier C.

positive: textbook cubic crystals from literature values (Cu: C11=168.4,C12=121.4,C44=75.4 GPa; Si: 165.7,63.9,79.6; diamond: 1079,124,578) must be PD in exact and float, with cubic Born conditions agreeing

Mouhat-Coudert footnote 26: C11=1/2, C22=C33=1, C12=-1, C13=C23=0 (shear constants not stated in the footnote; set C44=C55=C66=1, labelled) must PASS the linear Wu criterion and FAIL exact PD with a rational witness
known-unstable cubic tensor (C11<|C12| or C44<0) must be NOT_PD
pipeline internal: exact LDL^T verdict equals sympy leading-minor verdict on random rational matrices
negative: sign flip of C11 on each stable control flips verdict to NOT_PD
symmetry-breaking: a non-symmetric corruption of a stable control is detected as non-symmetric and its symmetrised verdict reported
rounding-boundary control: a singular tensor perturbed by +-1/2 unit must give AMBIGUOUS
tampered Lean certificate (wrong witness/LDL factor) rejected by the kernel (if Lean stretch executed)
controls.rule: All controls are run and logged before any dataset number is reported; a failing control stops the dataset run and is reported.

kill_criterion: KILL if the elastic tensors are unavailable, or any positive/negative control fails and cannot be repaired without changing the prereg (a repair is a logged deviation). Licence is CC BY 4.0, so the licence kill does not trigger; nonetheless only counts, code and per-class summaries are published, no per-entry bulk table.

outcome_rule.KEEP: all controls pass, whole dataset classified with exact verdicts agreeing between two implementations, and (certified NOT_PD fraction >= 1% of full-tensor entries OR certified exact 'none'), Lean control certificates kernel-checked
outcome_rule.PARTIAL: controls pass and classification complete but the nontrivial-count condition fails (0 < fraction < 1%) or the Lean stretch is not completed

tiers.C: exact rational results on the stored decimals (not Lean-checked)
tiers.A: only statements about specific tensors/witnesses kernel-checked in Lean
tiers.X: float pipelines, DFT-uncertainty margins, correlation with other fields

not_claimed: no claim that any material is synthesisable, stable or unstable in a laboratory; a DFT tensor is a calculation, not the material's tensor
no claim that JARVIS-DFT is wrong; entries that fail are entries needing care (finite-difference noise, unconverged cells)
ethics: public data only, licence recorded before download, no human-subject data, no contact with dataset authors
